summary: Anchored verifier input opens reject parent and leaf symlinks
details: The A1 frontier review reproduced an outside-checkout metadata read because lstat checked only the final path component and Path.open followed an ancestor symlink. The verifier now walks the lexical root and each fixed relative input component with directory descriptors and O_NOFOLLOW, opens leaves with O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK, then checks fstat type and size before bounded reads. Python 3.12.14 on macOS reports os.open dir_fd support and all required flags. Twenty-two owned cases pass, including the original sibling metadata escape shape, report/source/metadata parent and leaf symlinks, FIFO, directory, oversized and stale/malformed inputs, foreign-cwd success, unsupported-capability refusal, and stable descriptor counts over repeated success/refusal.
action: Replaced path-based lstat/open with an anchored component walk and retained the prior report, package, metadata, and Cargo source bytes unchanged.
outcome: Current verification succeeds; every negative fixture refuses in under 0.03 seconds with no timeout, and owned descriptor counts remain four across repeated success and refusal.
